title: The State of Mobile Creativity in 2026
prompt: Build a mobile market saturation infinite-runner for a tiny indie game in 2026. The player's game sprite runs left to right along an app store shelf while giant AI-generated competitor games slide in as obstacles. Collecting creativity tokens lets the player jump higher or flash unique art styles; collecting CPI dollar signs weighs the game down. Survival score is measured in 'weeks of attention'. Hyper-saturated neon mobile game aesthetic.
